system.description:
This spell cannot be used unless a storm of some (any) type is within range of the druid. (This does not mean that he must be within the spell's range of the storm cloud, but only that the stormy weather be taking place within 360' of him.)

If a storm is present, the druid may call 1 lightning bolt per turn (10 minutes) to strike at any point within range. The lightning bolt descends from the sky, hitting an area 20' across. Each victim within that area takes 8d6 (8-48) points of electrical damage, but may make a saving throw vs. spells to take half damage. The druid need not call the lightning every turn unless desired; it remains available until the spell duration (or the storm) ends.
system.effect: Calls lightning bolts from a storm
